provenance.method: Data tables vendored from the openstudio-standards NECB2020 MERGED standards_data (space_types_2020.json, schedules_2020.json — see their provenance blocks); article structure and values verified against the building-codes MCP server (necb:2020). Runtime never contacts the MCP.

verification.schedule_sets: Table A-8.4.3.2.(1)-A cell-verified against the vendored NECB-A-* schedules (occupants, lighting, receptacle, fans, 24C cooling / 18-20-22C heating setpoints, SWH fractions per Mon-Fri/Sat/Sun)
verification.load_densities: Table A-8.4.3.2.(2)-B (89 space functions) retrieved in full: occupant density m2/occupant, receptacle W/m2, SWH W/occupant, schedule letters, illuminance

articles.title: Thermal Blocks
articles.how: thermal-block/zoning decisions belong to the modeller or the HVAC autozoning layer, not the loads pass

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads, Service Water Heating Loads and Set-point Temperature
articles.how: occupancy and receptacle densities, thermostats and the NECB-letter schedule sets applied per space type from the NECB records (2025 values verified identical to 2020)
articles.gaps: lighting schedules are provided by openstudio-lighting and SWH schedules by openstudio-shw — apply them after apply_loads

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads, Service Water Heating Loads and Set-point Temperature
articles.how: internal loads and SWH loads representative of the space functions via the space-type records; ventilation OA and space-type infiltration from the same records
articles.gaps: illuminance levels are lighting-design data and are not modelled

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads, Service Water Heating Loads and Set-point Temperature
articles.gaps: the semi-heated set-point comes from the proposed building’s specifications — a modeller input; the pipeline keeps whatever thermostats the model carries

articles.title: Air Leakage
articles.how: implemented in the openstudio-envelope gem (8.4.3.3.(3) default air-leakage rule in its reference transform); the loads pass applies only the space-type modelling infiltration, which envelope rules may override

articles.title: HVAC System Operation
articles.how: fan/system operating schedules ship in the schedule sets (NECB-<letter>-Fan); wiring them to systems is the openstudio-hvac / umbrella layer

articles.title: Assumed chiller performance for Part 8 calculations (Table 8.4.3.5)
articles.how: Table 8.4.3.5 = assumed chiller COP/IPLV (Scroll < 528 kW: COP 2.802/IPLV 3.664; Screw >= 528 kW: COP 2.802/IPLV 3.737) — an HVAC calculation assumption, not a loads concern; the article body is not retrievable from the source extraction (correcting an earlier mislabel as simulation parameters)

articles.title: Internal and Service Water Heating Loads — internal slice
articles.how: Occupant, receptacle and miscellaneous loads applied from the NECB space-type data; (2) sensible/latent split and (3) schedule-driven adjustment are EnergyPlus behaviour of those inputs.

articles.title: Outdoor Air
articles.how: (1)(b): peak outdoor-air rates enter as DesignSpecification:OutdoorAir from the NECB space-type data (ventilation standard basis); the reference inherits them by clone. (1)(a): on the 2025 EUI path the umbrella normalizes OA to the ASHRAE 62.1 rates at the Table 8.4.4.2 occupant density (adopted interpretation 2026-07-22; btap-necb Archetypes).
